comment: R10 marquee alias table (E1), extended R11 (D58a). A bare family name either maps to its canonical primary (alternatives ride as candidates) or forces a curated disambiguation — marquee families never bind silently. Every symbol is verified against the NSE master at test time. TMCV replaces the delisted TATAMOTORS (2025 demerger; the passenger-vehicle sibling TMPV is also NSE-listed but the curated list carries one Tata Motors entry). l&t/larsen carry the flagship LT as primary (the V3 defect was 'L&T' silently binding LTF); LTIMindtree is deliberately absent from the alternatives because LTIM is not in the bundled NSE master. jindal/godrej are curated choosers (the V4 first-word-tie defect); jindal is capped at the six major names (_MAX_CANDIDATES) — 'jindal photo' still resolves JINDALPHOT by name. A bare 'lt' needs no entry: LT is an exact NSE ticker and binds deterministically before the marquee stage.
